name: EncryptionProvider
description: Provides the methods for setting up permissions, applying the cryptography of the underlying encryption and decryption, and user authentication.
remarks: Encryption providers are implemented through custom COM add-ins. You are provided with storage within Office documents for add-in specific information to store whatever information you need to encrypt, decrypt, apply rights, and display permission setup or authentication user interfaces.

methods.name: GetProviderDetail
methods.description: Displays information about the encryption of the current document.

parameters.name: encprovdet
parameters.description: Specifies the encryption information that you want.

methods.name: NewSession
methods.description: Used by the EncryptionProvider object to create a new encryption session. This session is used by the provider to cache document-specific information about the encryption, users, and rights while the document is in memory.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Specifies the window that is called to display the encryption settings.

methods.name: Authenticate
methods.signature: Authenticate(ParentWindow As IUnknown, EncryptionData As IUnknown, PermissionsMask As Long) As Long
methods.description: Used to determine whether the user has the proper permissions to open the encrypted document.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Specifies the window that is called to display the encryption settings.

parameters.name: EncryptionData
parameters.description: Contains the encrypted data for the current document.

parameters.name: PermissionsMask
parameters.description: The user interface displayed by the encryption provider add-in.

methods.name: CloneSession
methods.description: Creates a second, working copy of the EncryptionProvider object's encryption session for a file that is about to be saved.

parameters.name: SessionHandle
parameters.description: The ID of the cloned session.

parameters.name: SessionHandle
parameters.description: The ID of the current session.

methods.name: Save
methods.signature: Save(SessionHandle As Long, EncryptionData As IUnknown) As Long

parameters.name: SessionHandle
parameters.description: The ID of the current session.

parameters.name: EncryptionData
parameters.description: Contains the encryption information.

methods.name: EncryptStream
methods.signature: EncryptStream(SessionHandle As Long, StreamName As String, UnencryptedStream As IUnknown, EncryptedStream As IUnknown)
methods.description: Encrypts and returns a stream of data for a document.

parameters.name: SessionHandle
parameters.description: The ID of the current session.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the encrypted stream of document data.

parameters.name: UnencryptedStream
parameters.description: The data stream before encryption.

parameters.name: EncryptedStream
parameters.description: The data stream information after it has been encrypted.

methods.name: DecryptStream
methods.signature: DecryptStream(SessionHandle As Long, StreamName As String, EncryptedStream As IUnknown, UnencryptedStream As IUnknown)
methods.description: Decrypts and returns a stream of encrypted data for a document.

parameters.name: SessionHandle
parameters.description: The ID of the current session.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The ID of the stream of data.

parameters.name: EncryptedStream
parameters.description: The encrypted data stream.

parameters.name: UnencryptedStream
parameters.description: The data stream before dencryption.

methods.name: ShowSettings
methods.signature: ShowSettings(SessionHandle As Long, ParentWindow As IUnknown, ReadOnly As Boolean, Remove As Boolean)
methods.description: Used to display a dialog of the encryption settings for the current document.

parameters.name: SessionHandle
parameters.description: The ID of the current session.

parameters.name: ParentWindow
parameters.description: Specifies the window that is called to display the encryption settings.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Specifies whether you want the user to be able to change the encryption settings.

parameters.name: Remove
parameters.description: If True, the encryption for a document will be removed during the next save operation.
